title: Open APIs: A coming of age
summary: One of the hottest topics at this year’s Sibos conference in Geneva, Switzerland was open APIs (application programming interfaces), and how their introduction is causing concern among some financial institutions, while offering promising opportunities for early adopters. Regulations, such as Europe’s revised Payment Services Directive (PSD2) and others, is driving the move toward open APIs in financial services, and this blog explores some of the key technical issues discussed at Sibos.
